The market is expected to contract 3.4% for the full year, as China's domestic market plunges, Europe remains the only growth market among China, Europe, and the US, and the war involving Iran drives up oil prices and freight costs, creating both risks and opportunities for Taiwan's automotive suppliers.

title: MediaTek's Google TPU v9 faces potential delay over glass substrate yields, but 2026 orders remain strong
snippet: Market reports have recently suggested that MediaTek's tensor processing unit (TPU) v9 project with Google could face delays in volume production as Google reportedly revises the chip's design. Industry observers expect MediaTek may address some of these concerns during its earnings conference in late October.

title: Alibaba Backs Chinese Robovan Maker in $400 Million Fundraising
snippet: Neolix Technologies Co., a Chinese maker of driverless delivery vehicles, raised $400 million to fuel its global expansion.

title: ‘Open your doors for AI’: German chancellor urges businesses to embrace AI as Nvidia announces new investments

title: Выпуск версии OpenWrt 25.12.6
snippet: В середине октября 2026 года разработчики проекта OpenWrt для сетевых устройств, включая маршрутизаторы, коммутаторы и точки доступа, представили релиз дистрибутива OpenWrt 25.12.5. Сборка OpenWrt 25.12 вышла в марте 2026 года. Выпуск OpenWrt 24.10 состоялся в феврале 2025 года. Стабильный релиз OpenWrt 23.05 вышел в сентябре 2024 года. Читать далее

title: Вышло обновление Media Player Classic — Home Cinema 2.8.4
